source_name: ČNB — Vzájemné uznávání makroobezřetnostních opatření (reciprocita)
why_relevant: Records which foreign macroprudential measures ČNB reciprocates and from what date — a source of dated obligations on Czech banks that originate outside CZ and are easily missed by domestic-only monitoring.

source_name: ČNB — Makroobezřetnostní politika (hub) + Strategie makroobezřetnostní politiky
why_relevant: Master index of every macroprudential instrument page plus the strategy document that explains ČNB's reaction function — the best single crawl seed for this cell, and the strategy PDF is the interpretive key for reading future decisions.

source_name: ČNB — Strategie České národní banky v oblasti dohledu
why_relevant: Supervisory strategy and key supervisory priorities (klíčové dohledové priority) — states which aspects of supervised entities will be examined in more depth, including regular and extraordinary (thematic) assessments. Directly answers 'where is supervision heading next'.

source_name: ČNB — Výkon dohledu (supervision practice hub)
why_relevant: Hub for how supervision is actually conducted: licensing/approval proceedings, information-duty compliance, on-site and off-site supervision, international cooperation, public warnings and supervisory guidance. Best seed for enumerating supervisory output series beyond rules.

source_name: ČNB — Zátěžové testy (stress tests hub, incl. dohledové zátěžové testy)
why_relevant: Macro stress tests published twice yearly with the Financial Stability Report, plus a distinct 'dohledové zátěžové testy' (supervisory stress test) series for banks, insurers and pension companies — supervisory exercises whose results shape capital expectations.

source_name: ČNB — Tiskové zprávy (press releases on buffer / mortgage-limit decisions)
why_relevant: Each macroprudential decision is announced as a dated press release whose title itself encodes the outcome (increase / leave unchanged / decrease, and the new rate). Cheap, structured, low-latency signal that also states the effective date in the body.

source_name: ČNB — Proticyklická kapitálová rezerva: otázky a odpovědi / CCyB methodology note
why_relevant: Explains the decision mechanics that determine timing: quarterly rate-setting obligation, increases normally announced ~1 year ahead, decreases effective without delay. Essential for converting a decision into a forward calendar of bank obligations. The companion methodology PDF documents the buffer guide and ESRB-recommendation inputs.

source_name: ČNB — Tematické články o finanční stabilitě / Rizika pro finanční stabilitu a jejich indikátory
why_relevant: Thematic analytical articles (and the older 'Rizika pro finanční stabilitu a jejich indikátory' series) that pre-announce the analytical basis for later macroprudential moves — e.g. the article on the CCyB rate covering the usual level of cyclical risks preceded the neutral-rate framework. Leading indicator of policy direction.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR — Zpráva o vývoji finančního trhu
why_relevant: Annual Ministry of Finance companion to ČNB's supervisory report: sector-by-sector development plus a dedicated chapter on MF legislative activity that will shape future market rules (e.g. Digital Finance Market Act implementing DORA and MiCA). Gives the legislative-pipeline side that ČNB's supervisory report does not cover.

source_name: AKAT ČR — industry association coverage of ČNB supervisory reports
why_relevant: Industry association republishing and framing ČNB supervisory reports — useful as an independent redundancy channel and, more importantly, as a signal of which parts of a supervisory report the regulated industry considers material.

source_name: Kurzy.cz — CCyB rate time series page
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator presenting the countercyclical buffer rate history in one table — convenient for quick historical cross-checking of rate/effective-date pairs, but must be validated against the ČNB opatření obecné povahy, never treated as authoritative.

source_name: Fio banka / Seznam Zprávy — market press reporting on ČNB macroprudential decisions
why_relevant: Czech financial press and bank research desks summarise Bank Board financial-stability decisions within hours and add market interpretation; useful for gauging expected impact and for catching decisions if the ČNB feed is missed.

source_name: ČBA EducaPlus – kalendář akcí (Česká bankovní asociace, odborné semináře)
why_relevant: Training arm of the Czech Banking Association. Seminar titles and dates are a leading indicator of which obligations member banks are actually preparing for (DORA, PSD3/PSR/FIDA, SREP/ICAAP-ILAAP, AI audit, open banking). Sold-out/repeat notices signal intensity of demand.

source_name: Trendy v platebním styku ČR & SR (CGI, annual payments conference)
why_relevant: The single most agenda-revealing CZ/SK payments conference. Session titles map directly to obligations institutions are timing work against (PSD3/PSR, digital euro, eIDAS 2.0 / EU digital identity wallet, SEPA Instant, QR payments). Speaker list doubles as an actor map for A3.

source_name: CARDFORUM – conference of Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK / Bank Card Association)
why_relevant: Card-industry conference run by the CZ bank card association; programme PDFs (cardforum20XXinfo.pdf) name card-scheme mandates, security/SCA and card-payment regulatory topics banks are working on. Historically publishes machine-readable PDF agendas.

source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) – activities and seminars
why_relevant: Association body behind CARDFORUM; its activity/working-group pages point to card-security seminars and recommendations (e.g. internet payment security, payment account access), which precede or interpret supervisory expectations.

source_name: FinTech Roadmap (Česká fintech asociace / Česká Wealthtech asociace, hosted at ČNB congress centre)
why_relevant: Largest CZ fintech conference; 2026 edition held in the ČNB Congress Centre with regulators on panels. Programme opens on regulation, open banking and licensing — a direct read on which supervisory/licensing frictions the industry is lobbying and preparing for.

source_name: Česká fintech asociace (Czech Fintech Association) – site + LinkedIn
why_relevant: Organiser/co-organiser of fintech events and partner of regulatory law firms (e.g. FINREG PARTNERS on EU AI Act); its announcements and LinkedIn posts flag upcoming obligations members are being briefed on before official CZ guidance.

source_name: FINREG PARTNERS – regulatory law firm (career page + regulatory commentary)
why_relevant: Boutique CZ financial-regulation firm. Two indirect signals in one: (a) its own hiring for AML/compliance specialists, (b) client-facing commentary and seminar partnerships that name upcoming obligations. Job ad text often lists the exact regulations a practice is staffing up for.

source_name: Jobs.cz – compliance/regulatory vacancies in banking & payments
why_relevant: Largest CZ job board. Aggregate volume and the named regulations inside bank/PSP compliance ads (DORA, MiCA, AML/CFT, ESG-risk, výkaznictví) are a hiring-side leading indicator of which obligations are being resourced and on what horizon.

source_name: JenPráce.cz / Práce za rohem – secondary CZ job boards (AML & compliance roles)
why_relevant: Secondary boards republish bank/PSP compliance ads with full Czech-language duty descriptions (AML/CFT, GDPR, insurance & pension distribution regulation), often more scrapable than jobs.cz and useful as a redundancy channel.

source_name: Bank career pages (e.g. Partners banka – Specialista Compliance)
why_relevant: First-party bank job ads state which regulatory monitoring duties (AML, GDPR, regulatory watch) a specific institution is staffing — institution-attributable evidence that aggregators lose. Extendable to ČSOB, KB, ČS, Air Bank, Raiffeisenbank, Fio, MONETA career portals.

source_name: Verlag Dashöfer / kursy.cz – commercial compliance & AML training catalogue
why_relevant: Commercial trainer that markets courses by new legal obligations ('nová zákonná povinnost'). Course launches and repeat scheduling are a market-demand proxy for which CZ obligations are biting and when.

source_name: Vzdělávání VOX – finance & banking seminars (Platební styk pro pokročilé)
why_relevant: Runs recurring payments-law seminars explicitly framed as 'changes in CZ and EU payment regulation', aimed at banks, credit unions and PSPs. Course abstracts summarise upcoming legal changes and their effective dates.

source_name: konferenceseminare.cz – CZ conference/seminar aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregator that indexes CZ finance/banking conferences including Trendy v platebním styku. Best single discovery surface for new, previously unknown regulatory events and organisers.

source_name: EduCity.cz – CZ course & conference aggregator (finance/banking)
why_relevant: Second aggregator with historical archive of past conference editions, useful for reconstructing multi-year agenda trend lines (which regulatory topic appeared in which year).
